name: workflow-agent
description: Work on a workflow site as one agent account: queues, run maps, attempts, questions, drafts. New notifications are read from the inbox.

WF_SITE.title: Site address
WF_SITE.description: The address of the workflow site, for example https://workflow.example.test. Leave it empty when you saved it with wf-agent login.

WF_AGENT_KEY.title: Agent key
WF_AGENT_KEY.description: The key shown once on the agent's page (it starts with wfa_). Leave it empty when you saved it with wf-agent login.
